reviews.x: Absolute garbage.  I feel like I have been robbed.  Doesnt work, will not stay in place and the first time in a long time I am disgusted with a product I purchased on Amazon.  Talk about taking advantage of people during a global pandemic One star is the minimum,  it wouldn't allow me to do zero.

reviews.t: Happy to no longer breath in my mask
reviews.x: Works great for my 13 hour shift. Does not weigh the mask down nor does it leave marks on my face. No more itchy nose.

These are junk; hard/cheap plastic (not silicone as described).  They won't stay in place and are sized for a Barbie- no adult face would fit into them; additionally, they took 2+ weeks to arrive.  Do not waste your money on these.

Sewed flat trouser eyes on each side of the mask so they could be easily remove without falling out. Just slip them in & out to charge or wash masks. My little grandkids like them for school.  The plastic sheld doesn't end up on the floor.
I was looking for this item and was thrilled to find it at a good price. The quality is excellent.
It does seem to help breathe better while wearing it with a mask!
They make the masks more comfortable to wear and easier to talk.

reviews.t: Can be trimmed to fit your face better.
reviews.x: I was able to cut the bottom half off because the bottom would rub on my chin when talking.  I use it with a surgeon mask that has the folds in it to attach the silicone piece to.  It comes out of the pleat a lot but is workable and doesn't make the sides of the mask open too much as I worried it might.  The piece down the nose does leave a red mark on my nose though so thankfully I don't have to wear it for a long period of time.

When I have to wear a mask for a length of time I find it getting a bit claustrophobic because it is so close to my mouth and tends to get moist very easily inside the mask. This particular mask bracket does the trick in that it does hold the mask away from my mouth. It’s a little tricky at first and you have to find exactly how it fits best on your face, over your nose and down over your mouth. Sometimes it’s a little difficult to get it to stay inside of a cloth mask without securing it someho

reviews.t: NOT as helpful as was advertised
reviews.x: This product really did nothing me.  It would keep you from getting some make-up on your mask if you could stand to wear it all the time, but it was not comfortable to do so.  It did NOT help me be better understood when speaking or addressing others either.  It was worth a try and priced reasonably, but I would not recommend it as advertised because it did not do what the ads said it would.  And even though it was not terribly uncomfortable, it was not comfortable to wear for long periods of ti

I expected them to be a little softer/more flexible silicone molds, but they are sturdy and comfortable as-is.  They work best with a tri-fold type mask, because they have little hangers on either side to hook into place in those....but they can still be used with other types of masks and stay in place if your mask fits correctly.  It does help with breathing and vocal projection by not having your mask right up against your mouth.

I like that it keeps cloth mask off my mouth. Unfortunately it does not grasp the cloth folds the way it is described.  Perhaps the mask material is too thick.  I'm sure it works with disposable masks.  I also find i sweat under the bracket, getting kind of drippy after a while of walking.  Good idea but disappointing.  Nice that they c pico me 5 in a pack for families (I'm single).

These are MOSTLY what I hoped for.  They allow breathing to be more comfortable, and, to some extent if you wear them far enough down on the nose, help with the glasses fogging problem.  They are plastic to tend to sweat after you’ve worn them and breathed hot air on them for awhile, but they do keep your mask from sucking into your mouth.  I’m a singer, so this is important.

the clasps or clips or whatever are not placed in a convenient location and are useless to secure to the mask. You can slide it between two layers however it moves around and you still have the cloth between you and the bracket that you end up breathing in, which this is supposed to prevent. I will need to sew it in place which is extra work I didn't want to have to do.

reviews.t: Works, with little help with Velco
reviews.x: They are not that thick, it does fit most mask and small hooks don't stay in place when removing mask. I had to put a small piece of Velcro on the center nose bridge. then I stuck the glue side of velco on the mask where it was comfortable to keep the " muzzle " from falling out when removing the mask. It does help you breath and talk clearer.

I like using these but this seems a bit small. It looks like it’s supposed to sit on your face around your nose and down to your chin. This seemed a bit small as it was touching my bottom lip when I put it over my nose. It works when I place it below my nose. It seems to make my words clearer when speaking through a mask.

I got this to help with breathing and heat. I'm a teacher and it's easy to get overheated and out of breath with trying to project my voice through the masks. I was surprised with how small they were and how that say on my chin. It didn't help with the heat. Not long after I just ditched them. Great idea but not for me.

Hard to keep inside the mask.  There are some hook type things on the edge but no directions on how to place them.  I would have to sew sometime of hook or string inside my mask for them to attach.  Not practical.  Not worth the money which fortunately wasn't very much.  Right now they just sit in a closet unused.

It was the shape that didn’t fit my face that I had a problem with. It left a mark on my nose and chin and dug into my chin uncomfortably. I tried adjusting it but still hurt. I gave it to two of my African American Friends and it didn’t for their noses at all. Sorry!

Plastic, not silicone. Entirely inflexible and too small. I have a small face (adult who wears a child size mask) and this is too small for me. Any talking causes the entire piece to shift all the way down, pulling your mask below your nose. Completely ineffective.

reviews.t: I can breath from inside the mask perfectly but the clips are horrible
reviews.x: I  can actually breath from inside my mask. The purpose served perfectly however the clips are horrible. I doesn’t stay on a regular surgical mask, hospital issued mask. Every time i take my mask off, this braces kept falling.

reviews.t: Doesn't make much difference and does not come with any instructions.
reviews.x: I thought that I would be able to talk more clearly and breathe easier, but those issues are still there. Plus, the plastic does not stay in place and is distracting. Have to re-adjust it often. There are no instructions...

reviews.t: Not for use with surgical masks
reviews.x: They don’t work great a surgical mask. They move too much when you talk. A tighter mask that holds it in place might work better. Wish I could have gotten it to work though because it did feel better with it on!

It fits my face well (it frankly would be better if it were a bit larger), but I am a smaller than average man and this product could be somewhat uncomfortable to someone else when worn for long periods of time.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the bracket helps them breathe more comfortably and keeps the mask off their mouth and nose.
Several reviewers report the bracket does not stay in place or secure well to the mask.
Some reviewers complain the material is hard plastic rather than soft silicone as described.
A few reviewers find it uncomfortable or ineffective, including sweating under the bracket and no improvement in being understood when speaking.
Some reviewers note it can be trimmed or adjusted to fit better.
